title: Countable dense sequence in the Euclidean unit ball of n-covectors
statement: For all natural numbers P and n there is a sequence (b_k)_{k∈ℕ} in Λ^n = Covector (Euclid P) n (the continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P) with |b_k|_E ≤ 1 for every k, such that every β ∈ Λ^n with |β|_E ≤ 1 lies in the closure of {b_k : k ∈ ℕ} for the canonical normed topology of Λ^n. Here |α|_E = covectorEuclideanNorm α = √(Σ_{I strictly increasing} α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)})²), with e the standard basis of ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ b : ℕ → Covector (Euclid P) n, (∀ k, covectorEuclideanNorm (b k) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 → β ∈ closure (Set.range b)
